author: GoPro
description:
Stig Hoefnagel's POV for the win 🤝  The professional kite surfer and Red Bull King of the Air 2021 second runner-up executed his largest kite tow-up to date: a 135-meter vertical tow up in the desert of Oman. A kiteboarding tow-up of this scale demands far more than just going along for the ride—Stig was constantly adjusting for wind strength, ensuring stable line tension, and keeping the kite perfectly positioned in the window for maximum lift during the ascent.
